# Hypothesis: Output is 2x2 of the color with LARGEST absolute difference

def predict_output(input_grid):
    divider_row = 4  # horizontal bar at row 4
    
    cols_2_above = sum(1 for r in range(divider_row) if input_grid[r][2] != 0)
    cols_2_below = sum(1 for r in range(divider_row + 1, len(input_grid)) if input_grid[r][2] != 0)
    cols_4_above = sum(1 for r in range(divider_row) if input_grid[r][6] != 0)
    cols_4_below = sum(1 for r in range(divider_row + 1, len(input_grid)) if input_grid[r][6] != 0)
    
    diff_2 = abs(cols_2_above - cols_2_below)
    diff_4 = abs(cols_4_above - cols_4_below)
    
    print(f"2s: above={cols_2_above}, below={cols_2_below}, diff={diff_2}")
    print(f"4s: above={cols_4_above}, below={cols_4_below}, diff={diff_4}")
